name: SilverChoice PPO 3500 (sample)
sourceNote: Fictional plan written for this demo. Section wording is modeled on a Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) and Evidence of Coverage (EOC), not copied from any real plan.

sections.title: Deductible and out-of-pocket limit
sections.text: Your in-network deductible is $3,500 per person. Your out-of-network deductible is $7,000 per person. The deductible does not apply to preventive care or to primary care, specialist and urgent care copays. Your in-network out-of-pocket limit is $8,000 per person, and the out-of-network limit is $16,000. Copays, coinsurance and amounts you pay toward the deductible count toward the out-of-pocket limit. Premiums, balance-billed charges and services this plan doesn't cover do not.

sections.title: Office visits
sections.text: Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $30 copay in-network; 50% coinsurance after the deductible out-of-network. Specialist visit: $60 copay in-network; 50% coinsurance after the deductible out-of-network. You do not need a referral to see a specialist. Preventive care, screenings and immunizations: no charge in-network.

sections.title: Diagnostic tests and imaging
sections.text: Diagnostic tests such as x-rays and blood work: 30% coinsurance after the deductible in-network; 50% coinsurance after the deductible out-of-network. Imaging such as CT, PET and MRI scans: 30% coinsurance after the deductible in-network; 50% coinsurance after the deductible out-of-network. Prior authorization is required for CT, PET and MRI scans.

sections.title: Urgent and emergency care
sections.text: Urgent care: $75 copay in-network; 50% coinsurance after the deductible out-of-network. Emergency room care: $400 copay per visit, in-network and out-of-network. The emergency room copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital.

sections.title: Rehabilitation services
sections.text: Outpatient physical, occupational and speech therapy: $60 copay per visit in-network; 50% coinsurance after the deductible out-of-network. Coverage is limited to 30 visits per calendar year for all therapies combined.

sections.title: Services this plan does not cover
sections.text: This plan does not cover: acupuncture; bariatric surgery; cosmetic surgery; hearing aids; long-term care; non-emergency care when traveling outside the U.S.; routine foot care; weight loss programs.

sections.title: Prior authorization
sections.text: Some services need approval from the plan before you receive them. Your in-network provider requests prior authorization for you. Services that need prior authorization include CT, PET and MRI scans, inpatient admissions that are not emergencies, and outpatient surgery. If you use an out-of-network provider, you are responsible for getting prior authorization. Without it, the plan may reduce or deny payment.

sections.title: Out-of-network providers and balance billing
sections.text: Out-of-network providers have no contract with the plan and may bill you for the difference between their charge and the plan's allowed amount. This is called balance billing. Balance-billed amounts do not count toward your deductible or out-of-pocket limit. The No Surprises Act protects you from balance billing for emergency care and for certain care at in-network facilities.

name: BronzeCare HMO 6500 (sample)
sourceNote: Fictional plan written for this demo. Section wording is modeled on a Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) and Evidence of Coverage (EOC), not copied from any real plan.

sections.title: Deductible and out-of-pocket limit
sections.text: Your deductible is $6,500 per person. The deductible does not apply to preventive care, primary care copays or urgent care copays. Your out-of-pocket limit is $8,500 per person. This plan does not cover out-of-network care except emergencies, so there is no separate out-of-network deductible or limit.

sections.title: Office visits
sections.text: Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $50 copay. Specialist visit: 40% coinsurance after the deductible. You need a referral from your primary care provider before you see a specialist. Without a referral, the visit is not covered. Preventive care, screenings and immunizations: no charge.

sections.title: Diagnostic tests and imaging
sections.text: Diagnostic tests such as x-rays and blood work: 40% coinsurance after the deductible. Imaging such as CT, PET and MRI scans: 40% coinsurance after the deductible. Prior authorization is required for CT, PET and MRI scans.

sections.title: Urgent and emergency care
sections.text: Urgent care: $100 copay. Emergency room care: 40% coinsurance after the deductible, in-network or out-of-network.

sections.title: Rehabilitation services
sections.text: Outpatient physical, occupational and speech therapy: 40% coinsurance after the deductible, limited to 20 visits per calendar year for all therapies combined. A referral is required.

sections.title: Services this plan does not cover
sections.text: This plan does not cover: acupuncture; bariatric surgery; chiropractic care; cosmetic surgery; hearing aids; out-of-network care except emergencies; routine eye care for adults.

sections.title: Your primary care provider and referrals
sections.text: Each member chooses a primary care provider (PCP) from the plan's network. Your PCP coordinates your care and gives you referrals to in-network specialists. You do not need a referral for emergency care, urgent care, preventive care or in-network OB-GYN visits.

sections.title: Care outside the network
sections.text: Except for emergency care, this plan does not pay for care from out-of-network providers, even with a referral. If you receive non-emergency care out of network, you pay the full cost, and it does not count toward your deductible or out-of-pocket limit.
